g.text: ✔ control: an untouched starter file keeps the gate ON, with the short label and the next step
✔ control: an open-and-save with the same size does not count as begun (still ON)
✔ control: a real edit (new size, after the baseline) turns the gate OFF
✔ control: an edit made before the baseline does not count
✔ control: HOLD keeps it quiet (held line, not the gate); "settled" arms it and the gate is ON
✔ control: a hold that runs out arms on its own; hold hours are capped at 3
✔ control: fake clock past 48 h with no watched change turns the idle trigger ON
✔ idle trigger ignores files outside the extension list, skipped folders and dot folders
✔ control: evidence older than everyDays turns a recurring item back ON
✔ a recurring item with a watched file needs a fresh size change inside its window
✔ deadlines file: open and due within 48 h is ON; later, past, closed, covered or evidenced entries are not
✔ items: a future "from" is off unless due within 48 h; done is off; no dates means always active
✔ snapshot records sizes for plain path strings, so a same-size save is ON and an edit is OFF
✔ a path without a known size counts on any save after the baseline; a folder counts any new file
✔ a folder item can name its own extensions (here Markdown)
✔ a missing file is not begun, and a file created after the snapshot counts
✔ pause: a reason is required, the hours are capped at 4, and the gate returns when it ends
✔ pause by typing it: "pause focus gate 2h <reason>" pauses; without a reason nothing changes; resume ends it
✔ a sentence ABOUT the pause phrase does not pause
✔ system, agent and cross-session prompts, other events and unattended runs get no output
✔ fails silent: no config, a corrupt config, garbage stdin, odd shapes
✔ CLI: status is one JSON object; usage errors exit 2; a missing config exits 1; --help exits 0
✔ speed: a cold decision over 3,000 files takes under 200 ms; the scan honours its caps
✔ examples: config.example.json is valid and gates once its paths point somewhere real; settings snippet is valid
✔ M3: a scan cut short by its caps neither fires the idle trigger nor is cached
✔ M4: lock, backup, swap and partial-download files never count as work
✔ L2: a person typing an arrow is still a person; a labelled peer message is not
✔ L3: deadline ids and titles are cleaned and clipped before they reach the context
ℹ tests 28
ℹ pass 28
ℹ fail 0
